title: Bonus Points Schedule: Enrollment, Upgrade, Pet Birthday and Goodwill (Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus)
content:
Bonus points figures of **Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus**, per tier.

| Tier | Enrollment bonus (first joining of the tier) | Tier-upgrade bonus (free tier earned by spend) | Pet birthday bonus per eligible pet | Pets per membership with a birthday bonus in one calendar year | Goodwill: largest award in one contact | Goodwill: largest total in any rolling 365 days |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pals Rewards Member | 100 | 0 | 100 | 2 | 250 | 500 |
| Pals Rewards Insider | 0 | 200 | 250 | 3 | 500 | 1000 |
| Pals Rewards VIP | 0 | 500 | 500 | 4 | 750 | 1500 |
| Tailwise Plus Monthly | 500 | 0 | 500 | 4 | 750 | 1500 |
| Tailwise Plus Annual | 1000 | 0 | 500 | 4 | 750 | 1500 |
| Tailwise Plus Premier Annual | 1500 | 0 | 1000 | 6 | 1000 | 2000 |

All figures are points.

**Pet profile age, every tier.** The pet profile must have been on the account at least 30 calendar days before the pet's birthday.

## Questions the schedule answers

*Which tiers carry a tier-upgrade bonus?* Only the two free tiers earned by spend: 200 points for Pals Rewards Insider and 500 points for Pals Rewards VIP.

*How many pets can earn a birthday bonus on a Tailwise Plus Premier Annual membership in one year?* Up to 6, at 1000 points each.

*What is the goodwill room on a Pals Rewards VIP membership?* At most 750 points in one contact and at most 1500 points in any rolling 365 days.
